forum.title: ST MCU FINDER PC v 6.1.0 stop downloading updates
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@SToma

Let me thank you for posting.

ST MCU FINDER is no longer under maintenance and will not receive any further updates.

For selecting your next STM32 MCU, please use STM32 MCU Finder online:

<https://www.st.com/mcufinder>

If you are looking for a board finder, please use:

<https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/stm32-mcu-developer-zone/boards-and-hardware-tools.html>

Thanks.

Mahmoud
